newsitem.title: USA: Amcore Financial forms investment unit.
newsitem.headline: Amcore Financial forms investment unit.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Tuesday it formed Amcore Investment Group N.A., a new subsidiary that combines functions of Amcore Trust Co, Amcore Capital Management Inc and Amcore Investment Services Inc.
It said the new entity will give Amcore flexibility in providing investment advice, estate planning and management of employee retirement plans.
The trust portion of the new company includes both personal and employee benefits accounts with more than $2.4 billion in assets under administration.
Amcore Financial is a $2.7 billion assets bank holding company.
